notes: BetPool (src/BetPool.sol) is a pari-mutuel betting pool for NIGHTSHIFT games and Agent Arena. Its constructor takes no arguments and makes no external calls; it sets EIP-712 domain NightshiftBets/1, stores the initial signer and sets the initial per-bet limits (IMD 0.1-500, SHIFT 1000-25000000 whole tokens). Fixed constants: owner 0x6c4c78f2c3bdf4c4318fe305fb1c8bc1694d19b5 (named in the brief), tokens IMD 0xd34a99bc0f67ae1bbd63c660e6d0b0dd03e263b7 and SHIFT 0xe5e58e53d0bb204aa62c995a6c8cc8a48e60c3ac, fee splitter 0x1119d5df2f046bc2d3c0f6279ef2e9ce49422d44, 5% fee on the losing side only, hard caps 10000 IMD and 500000000 SHIFT. The signer starts as INITIAL_SIGNER 0x3B5919586FC04F7e99b450a72bcB14Eeb6977497, the EOA that NIGHTSHIFT's GameEscrow 0xf460fd9ad76f18414f54a2431870e8a116193489 returns from signer() on Ethereum mainnet; it is a compile-time constant, not a live read, and the constructor emits SignerSet for it. The owner can only setSigner (to rotate that key), setLimits within the caps, and pause/unpause new markets and bets; settle, expire and claim always work. No proxy, delegatecall, selfdestruct or token sweep.
